note: Official alerts only. Copied from the published alert pages; never from crowd reports.

alerts.title: WHO Medical Product Alert N°1/2020

lots.result: No quinine identified; traces of chloroquine

alerts.quote: Recently received results of analysed samples show they do not contain any of the expected active ingredients.
signs: Grey or white plastic tubs of 1000 loose tablets
Outdated WHO Essential Drugs Programme logo
English and French labels with mistakes
Remedica confirms it never used this batch number
alerts.advice: If you hold this product, do not use it. Report to your national medicines regulator.
alerts.photo_credit: Photo: WHO, Medical Product Alert N°1/2020

alerts.title: NAFDAC Public Alert No. 01/2026

lots.result: Relabelled older expired batch; sold on the open market (Idumota, Lagos)

alerts.quote: The affected packs did not originate from the authorised supply chain.
signs: Batch, manufacture and expiry dates on removable stickers on the blister
Authentication scratch label from the wrong provider
alerts.advice: Do not dispense. Quarantine and report to NAFDAC.
